title: Hand-drawn sighting location map: Fall Creek, Fall Creek Blvd, E 56th St bridge
description: Hand-drawn sketch map with a north arrow showing "Fall Creek", "Fall Creek Blvd", "E 56th St", areas of "WOODS", a "Clearing", and a "Cantilever Type Bridge", with an arrow marking the "Path of Object" near the bridge. A boxed area at lower right is labeled "Lady wood School (Approx 1/4 mi f/sighting". The map carries the typed signature block of a USAF 1st Lt. intelligence officer and struck-through CONFIDENTIAL stamps.
